contractPurpose: One bounded synthetic AWS SES SendEmail diagnostic using the hardened RouteMind adapter; preparation only until this exact new digest is approved

executionPath.transport: AWS SDK for Java v2 SesClient.sendEmail

runtimePreconditions: Human approval matches this exact new contract SHA-256
Prior consumed contracts and all prior evidence remain unchanged
AWS_PROFILE is exactly routemind-ses in the execution process
AWS_REGION and AWS_DEFAULT_REGION are exactly ap-northeast-1 in the execution process
ROUTEMIND_NOTIFICATION_SENDER and ROUTEMIND_NOTIFICATION_SYNTHETIC_RECIPIENT are present without persisting values
DefaultCredentialsProvider resolves locally before the send without a service call
No conflicting SDK profile override is present
Sender and synthetic recipient are provider-verified for the bounded test
Sender normalized-form match is true and sender boundary whitespace/display-name syntax are false
Recipient normalized-form match is true and recipient boundary whitespace/display-name syntax are false
Request shape is source=1, To=1, CC=0, BCC=0, duplicate recipients=false
Endpoint and region overrides are absent and SDK retry policy is zero
Consent-valid transactional Outbox intent and opaque notification identity are ready
Redacted evidence sink and leakage scan are ready before any request
No fallback result is substituted for an AWS result
stopConditions: Any contract digest, provider, operation, region, profile, identity source, request shape, or budget mismatch
Any missing or invalid non-secret configuration or local credential-chain failure
Any attempt to use the historical ad-hoc helper, SendRawEmail, batch, fallback, or retry
Any attempt to create or mutate an AWS account, IAM policy, SES configuration, or resource
Any sender, recipient, message content, business data, payment data, or credential leakage risk
Any second request, recipient, attachment, CC, BCC, or bulk operation
Any wall-clock deadline or USD 0.10 ceiling reached or plausibly exceeded
Unexpected authentication, quota, billing, endpoint, region, or provider response semantics
Provider acceptance without a trustworthy redacted artifact
Any fallback or local result that could be mistaken for AWS provider truth
Mailbox delivery cannot be independently confirmed after acceptance; classify partial and do not send again

consumptionSemantics.consumedBeforeProviderCall: only if local terminal failure is recorded under repository execution semantics
consumptionSemantics.subsequentAttempt: requires a new independent contract and Human Gate

evidenceContract.secretHandling: no credential, sender, recipient, message body, raw provider token, or browser material may be persisted
evidenceContract.providerMetadata: record only sanitized structured fields, redacted correlation, and digests

outcomeSemantics.PASS: Exactly one bounded SendEmail request is accepted, no boundary is violated, a valid provider success identifier is recorded in redacted form, and leakage scan passes; this is synthetic provider validation only, never production validation
outcomeSemantics.PARTIAL: The single request is accepted or partially observed but authenticated delivery/bounce, cost, or another required evidence item is missing; retain the result and make no delivery claim
outcomeSemantics.FAIL: The request is rejected, times out, violates a boundary, leaks data, or cannot produce a trustworthy redacted artifact; retain the failure and do not retry under this contract
outcomeSemantics.LOCAL_PRECONDITION_FAILURE: Abort before AWS with zero AWS requests, preserve the local blocker, and do not silently rerun
outcomeSemantics.fallback: Forbidden for this diagnostic; no local result may represent AWS provider truth

humanGate.approvalStatementTemplate: I approve R4-422 AWS SES third single-send diagnostic contract contracts/provider/r4-422-aws-ses-third-single-send-diagnostic-v1.json by exact SHA-256 digest <DIGEST>, authorize exactly one synthetic SendEmail request in ap-northeast-1 through the hardened RouteMind AwsSesNotificationProvider/AwsSesRequestFactory path, with exactly one approved synthetic verified recipient, zero retries, zero fallback, a USD 0.10 ceiling, and a 15-minute execution window; I authorize no IAM, SES configuration, account, or resource mutation, accept sanitized evidence and fail-closed semantics, and confirm that historical R4-422 SES contracts are not reused.
